text: {"recheck_passed":true,"discrepancy_pct":0.0,"sample_size":8,"confidence":0.6,"issues":["Sample is very small: only 8 EU orders total (4 in June, 4 in July), of which 1 June refund and 3 July refunds drive the entire change — the $240 swing rests on 4 refund records, so it is not statistically meaningful.","July's $260 across 3 refunds averages ~$87 per refund versus June's single $20 refund; the increase is driven by both refund count and much larger per-refund amounts, which the summary does not separate.","The reported metrics do not identify a root cause; 'shipping_delay' is a stated reason code, not a verified explanation, so the answer to the 'why' question remains unresolved.","Refund rate is 100% for every order with a refund reason, suggesting full-order refunds; this pattern is worth confirming rather than treating as a partial-refund trend."]}
